ownership_source: auth.uid() from verified Google JWT; no owner UID input parameter

rpcs.name: buyer_pilot_first_claim
rpcs.implementation: Check private card/window registry; derive auth.uid(); establish private transaction context; call existing atomic buyer_first_claim internally; project only success/result code

rpcs.name: buyer_pilot_list_cards
rpcs.filter: pilot card only AND buyer_card_ownership.user_id = auth.uid()

rpcs.name: buyer_pilot_redirect_target
rpcs.public_delivery: HTTP 302 Location to canonical Google Review; no URL in public status JSON

owner_update: not enabled by this claim-only pilot
public_view_privacy: Exclude this exact pilot card with IS DISTINCT FROM predicate, preserving existing anon policy for every other row including NULL legacy codes
claim_expiry: enforced in DB; does not delete ownership or automatically disable already-approved active redirect/owner read
normal_close: deny claim writes; preserve committed card, ownership, audits, approved owner read and active redirect
emergency_close: deny all pilot operations; no deletion/reset/automatic restore
